newsitem.title: USA: Orange Cty, N.C. urged to issue $60 mln school GOs.
newsitem.headline: Orange Cty, N.C. urged to issue $60 mln school GOs.

text.p: A task force has recommended that North Carolina's Orange County seek voter approval for $60 million of general obligation bonds for school construction.
The proposal was released Tuesday and is scheduled to go before the county board of commissioners on May 6.
Combined with proceeds from North Carolina's statewide bond program, it would finance construction of two new schools and renovation and expansion at several others.

The plan would require the county to raise property taxes by about $40 a year for the owner of a $100,000 home. The maximum bond amount that would not require a tax increase would be $40 million, county commissioners said when they created the task force earlier this year.
